You'll lead complex evaluations in regulated environments and shape the technical strategy for opportunities across hybrid, on-premises, and public cloud environments.

You'll own the technical evaluation experience from discovery through decision. You'll influence agency stakeholders and coordinate with systems integrators, resellers, and technology partners. You'll help customers and account teams address security, compliance, acquisition, and deployment requirements while setting accurate expectations about capabilities, prerequisites, and solution design.

• Own the sales process in partnership with Account Executives by leading and shaping the technical strategy across opportunities from PG to Closed Won

Bitwarden helps enterprises, developers, and individuals securely store and share sensitive data. We're open source, and our products cover password management, secrets management, and passwordless and passkey innovation. Founded in 2016 and headquartered in Santa Barbara, California, we're backed by a global community of security experts and enthusiasts.

LATAM is a channel-first region for us. As channel manager, you'll build the partner ecosystem across Latin America, own a quota, and get resellers and MSPs selling Bitwarden on their own.

What you'll do

• Own a regional go-to-market plan for LATAM, with priority markets such as Brazil, Mexico, Colombia, Chile, and Argentina

• Recruit and onboard regional resellers, MSPs, and local and boutique VARs, plus distributors where they're the right route to market

• Build and maintain a partner plan that maps each partner's strengths (customer relationships, vertical focus, technical specialty) to target accounts

• Manage lead flow both ways between partners and Bitwarden Sales, run deal registration, and keep sales leaders current on channel pipeline and forecast

• Set financial goals with focus partners and drive them to hit those goals

• Join partner sales calls to provide product expertise and help close deals

• Work through LATAM-specific deal mechanics with Finance and Legal, including local-currency pricing, invoicing and tax requirements, payment terms, and data residency questions (LGPD in Brazil, for example)

• Run several channel initiatives at once across technical, professional services, and sales

What you bring

• 5-10 years in partner development, channel management, or sales, with a record of hitting quota

• Existing relationships with LATAM resellers, MSPs, or distributors in security or IT

• Fluent in Spanish or Portuguese and English.Experience with both global and boutique VARs, and with how channel works in the region: tiered distribution, local entities, and longer public-sector cycles

• Comfort working remotely with minimal supervision across time zones, with regular travel in-region for partner meetings and events

• A bachelor's degree in business, marketing, or a related field

• A self-starter mindset and a bias toward solving problems yourself

Interview process

• Screening call with our recruiting manager

• Hiring manager interview (head of channel sales)

• Interview with our CSO

• Interview with our head of sales enablement

• Final interview with our CEO

• Reference checks

Why Bitwarden

• Mission. Our community loves us, and you'll bring better security to everyone from families to the world's largest organizations.

• Market. You'll become an expert in two growing markets: security and open-source software.

• Growth. You'll build channel, demand gen, and product-led growth experience in a fast-growing company.

• Team. Work remotely with motivated people around the world, with in-person meetups.

Skills

For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.

613f7af0774bf307.description:
Headquarters: US - Remote

Company Description

At Amwell, we’re transforming healthcare for all—powered by technology and inspired by people. Here, your ideas don’t just matter—they drive real change, improving lives on a global scale.

We marry technology and innovation with clinical excellence to provide trusted solutions that solve the healthcare industry’s biggest pain points and are on a mission to enable greater access to more convenient, affordable, and effective care. 

We do this through our technology-enabled care platform that is designed to help our clients achieve their digital care ambitions – today and in the future. We offer programs spanning the full care continuum, including urgent, acute and specialty care, behavioral health, and services for the treatment of chronic conditions such as heart and cardiometabolic diseases. Programs are powered by Amwell as well as our growing partner network.

For almost two decades, Amwell has proudly served some of the largest and most sophisticated healthcare organizations in the U.S. and worldwide. Our team is passionate about technology’s role in transforming care delivery and making it more equitable, accessible, efficient, cost-effective and navigable for all.
Brief Overview 

We're looking for a practical, business-minded attorney to join Amwell's Legal team as Senior Legal Counsel. The heart of this role is federal commercial contracting and compliance—you'll be our go-to person for prime contracts, subcontracts, flow-down requirements, and the program compliance obligations that come with doing business with the government.

From that foundation, you'll also get plenty of variety: supporting clinical contracting and lending a hand on employment, privacy, regulatory, and litigation matters as they come up. If you enjoy being close to the business, like the mix of deep specialty work and broad generalist support, and get satisfaction from being the person teams turn to for a clear, sensible answer, you'll feel right at home here.

You'll partner with colleagues across Sales, HR, Clinical, Finance, Operations, and Compliance. We care about your judgment, your curiosity, and your willingness to roll up your sleeves—so if you don't check every single box below, we'd still love to hear from you.

Core Responsibilities 

• Lead federal government contracting. Legal subject matter expert for the commercial and compliance side of Amwell's federal government contracts—prime contracts, subcontracts, flow-down requirements, and program compliance obligations. This is the core of the role.

• Draft and negotiate commercial agreements. Independently handle time-sensitive contracts with U.S. and international customers, partners, vendors, and healthcare providers—including SaaS, software licensing, clinical services, professional services, business associate, reseller, and data protection agreements.

• Be a trusted advisor to the business. Help stakeholders think through contract structure, risk allocation, procurement requirements, healthcare regulatory considerations, privacy and data terms, and operational commitments—translating all of it into plain, actionable guidance.

• Support RFI/RFP responses. Provide legal and compliance review on customer proposals, including government procurement materials, certifications, contractual exceptions, and risk review.

• Help us stay compliant. Pitch in on regulatory and compliance work and special projects—especially where commercial, healthcare, privacy, and government program requirements intersect.

• Support employment matters. Work alongside HR and the Head of Legal on employment and separation agreements, workplace policies, and the everyday employment questions that come up at a growing company.

• Lend a hand on disputes and litigation. Help manage litigation holds, gather relevant information, coordinate with internal teams, outside parties, and outside counsel, support discovery and subpoenas, and weigh in on legal risk and settlement strategy.

• Collaborate across the company. Partner with cross-functional teams to land approvals on non-standard terms, take part in deal desk review, and make sure our commitments are accurately captured and realistic to deliver.

• Make us better as you go. Contribute to our contract templates, playbooks, processes, compliance controls, and self-service tools so the whole team works smarter over time.

• Get to know our world. Build a solid understanding of Amwell's healthcare technology platform, product roadmap, and provider services model so your advice is grounded in how the business actually works.

Qualifications

• A J.D. from an ABA-accredited law school and active, good-standing membership in at least one U.S. state bar.

• Fifteen more years of relevant legal experience, including meaningful commercial contracting work. In-house experience at a technology, healthcare, digital health, or SaaS company is a plus.

• Strong experience with federal, state, or local government contracting—procurement requirements, flow-down clauses, subcontracting, compliance obligations, public-sector RFPs, and regulated program support. This is central to the role, so it's a strong preference.

• Experience drafting and negotiating a range of agreements (technology, SaaS, software licensing, healthcare provider services, business associate, data protection, and professional services).

• Sound, practical judgment: the ability to spot what really matters, explain it clearly to non-lawyers, and offer a sensible path forward.

• Comfort with ambiguity—you can assess legal and operational risk, make a recommendation, and keep things moving without perfect information.

• Strong organizational instincts and attention to detail, with a knack for tracking complex contract, compliance, and stakeholder requirements.

• Clear, friendly written and verbal communication.

• A collaborative spirit—you genuinely enjoy working across teams and meeting people where they are.

Nice to have

• A T1 public trust clearance (or eligibility for one).

• Familiarity with healthcare technology, digital health, telehealth, health plans, providers, privacy, or data security.

Do Well. Live Well. At Amwell. 

Driven by our mission and values, we foster a workplace where Delivering Awesome, being Customer First and operating as One Team aren’t just aspirations – they are how we work, every day.  

Our people are our greatest asset. We strive to empower their growth and development not only as Amwellians but as individuals, through generous total rewards packages, a virtual-first work environment, work-life flexibility, including Summer Fridays and designated Mental Health Days, as well as opportunities to stretch and learn – to name a few. It’s our people who truly differentiate us. Ask anyone and they’ll tell you – you’ll never work with more passionate, more driven and more caring team members.    

We champion a culture of respect and inclusion, accountability and integrity, innovation and collaboration. At Amwell, you’ll do the most meaningful work of your career—improving healthcare for millions, growing alongside incredible teammates, and being valued for who you are.  

Benefits 

• Flexible Personal Time Off (Vacation time)

• 401K match

• Competitive healthcare, dental and vision insurance plans

• Paid Parental Leave (Maternity and Paternity leave)

• Employee Stock Purchase Program

• Free access to Amwell’s Telehealth Services, SilverCloud and The Clinic by Cleveland Clinic’s second opinion program

• Free Subscription to the Calm App

• Tuition Assistance Program

• Pet Insurance 

Salaried, Exempt Roles

616210b22f9b9e62.description: **About the Role** We are looking for a Big Data Engineer to design, build, and operate large-scale data pipelines and analytical infrastructure that transform high-volume raw data into reliable, query-ready datasets for analytics, reporting, and data-driven products. Our data platform ingests and processes data from multiple sources and serves analytics, data science, product, and downstream applications. In this role, you will own data pipelines end-to-end—from ingestion and transformation to warehousing, orchestration, data quality, and observability. **A key part of the role is owning ClickHouse as our primary analytical data store. You will be responsible for designing scalable data models, optimizing query performance, and ensuring the platform remains reliable and cost-efficient as data volumes and workloads grow.** You will work closely with data scientists, analysts, product engineers, and other engineering teams to build a modern, cloud-native data platform. **What You'll Do** Design, build, and maintain robust batch and streaming data pipelines that ingest data from multiple sources into analytical data stores. Build and operate Apache Airflow DAGs, including scheduling, dependencies, retries, backfills, idempotency, concurrency, and failure handling. Develop analytics-ready datasets using dbt, following well-structured staging, intermediate, and mart layers with appropriate tests, documentation, and incremental models. **Own ClickHouse as the primary analytical store, including:** Schema and table design using the MergeTree family of engines Partitioning and sorting/primary key strategies Materialized views Distributed and replicated table architectures Query and memory optimization High-volume data ingestion and performance tuning Work with BigQuery where cloud data-warehouse patterns are appropriate, including data modeling and query/cost optimization. Design and operate NoSQL and key-value data stores, including Bigtable, DynamoDB, and Redis, based on specific access patterns and performance requirements. Build and maintain data-quality frameworks covering validation, testing, freshness, completeness, reconciliation, and anomaly detection. Implement monitoring, alerting, structured logging, and observability for data pipelines and services. Own pipeline SLAs, incident response, troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis. Manage backfills, safe re-runs, schema evolution, and data migrations while minimizing downstream impact. Build reproducible, containerized environments using Docker and contribute to CI/CD and Infrastructure as Code practices. Partner with analysts, data scientists, product managers, and product engineers to translate business and technical requirements into scalable data models and pipelines. Continuously improve pipeline reliability, scalability, performance, and infrastructure cost efficiency. **Must-Have Requirements 4-6 years of experience in data engineering or a closely related field, with strong hands-on production experience.** Expert-level SQL and strong Python skills, with experience writing production-grade, maintainable, and well-tested code. Strong hands-on experience with Apache Airflow or a comparable workflow orchestration platform, including DAG design, scheduling, retries, backfills, dependency management, idempotency, and concurrency. Hands-on experience with dbt or a comparable transformation/ELT framework, including modular models, testing, source management, documentation, and incremental processing. Expert-level production experience with ClickHouse. This is a core requirement and should include: MergeTree engine family Partitioning and primary/sorting keys Materialized views Distributed and replicated tables Query and memory optimization High-volume ingestion and performance tuning Production experience with a cloud-based columnar/OLAP warehouse, such as BigQuery, including data modeling and performance/cost optimization. Hands-on experience with NoSQL and key-value databases, such as Bigtable, DynamoDB, and Redis, including data modeling, partition/key design, access patterns, and caching strategies. Strong understanding of ETL/ELT and dimensional/layered data modeling principles. Experience with GCP and/or AWS and familiarity with Docker, Git, and CI/CD. Strong focus on data quality, reliability, observability, and correctness. Strong ownership, problem-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across engineering, analytics, data science, and product teams. **Nice-to-Have** Experience with search platforms such as Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, Apache Solr, or Vespa, including indexing pipelines, schema design, and relevance/performance tuning. Experience with Aerospike or other high-performance, low-latency distributed key-value/NoSQL systems. Experience building streaming and event-driven pipelines using Kafka, Pub/Sub, or similar technologies. Experience with Change Data Capture (CDC) patterns and technologies. Experience with Apache Spark and data-lake architectures using object storage such as GCS or S3. Experience with Terraform or other Infrastructure as Code tools and Kubernetes. Experience with data-quality and observability tools such as Great Expectations, Soda, Monte Carlo, or advanced dbt testing. Understanding of data platform cost optimization / FinOps practices. Experience handling high-volume e-commerce, product catalog, behavioral, or event data. Familiarity with a second backend programming language, particularly Go. **What Success Looks Like** Data pipelines are reliable, well-tested, observable, and consistently meet freshness and completeness SLAs. Data models are clean, scalable, documented, and trusted by analytics, data science, and product teams. Data-quality issues are identified before they impact downstream consumers. Pipeline failures are diagnosed and resolved quickly, with clear root-cause analysis and preventive actions. ClickHouse and the broader analytical platform scale smoothly with growing data volumes and query workloads. Data infrastructure remains performant and cost-efficient as usage grows. Downstream teams can confidently rely on the platform for analytics, reporting, experimentation, and data-driven product experiences.

6104b6349a4fcdda.description: Job Description: Business Analyst Experience: 4+yrs Location: Chennai/Bangalore About the Role: We are seeking a Business Analyst with strong business acumen, analytical & problem-solving skills, to join our Data to Intelligence team. This role is at the intersection of business, technology, and customer engagement — translating complex problem statements into Data/AI-driven solutions, conducting data analysis to validate hypotheses and optimize outcomes. Key Responsibilities: Customer Requirement Analysis Engage with clients to understand business challenges, pain points, requirements, and desired outcomes. Document and validate requirements, ensuring clarity and alignment with business objectives. Define success metrics and measurable business impact. Solution Design: Translate business problems into AI-driven solution designs. Partner with data scientists and engineers to ensure feasibility and scalability, Build & Deploy the solutions and monitor the outcomes produced Map customer data sources to reporting and BI requirements, designing data models, dashboards, and reporting structures. Presales Solutioning: Collaborate with sales and solution architects for proposals. Develop proof-of-concepts, demos, and solution narratives tailored to client needs. Support RFP/RFI responses with business requirement insights and solution frameworks. Data Analysis & Experimentation: Perform hypothesis testing, A/B testing, and other statistical analyses to validate solution effectiveness. Interpret data trends to provide actionable insights for clients. Recommend optimizations based on experimental results and business KPIs. Stakeholder Collaboration: Act as the bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams. Present solution designs, reporting frameworks, and analytical findings to leadership and clients. Documentation & Delivery: Prepare BRDs, functional specifications, solution blueprints, and reporting requirement documents. Support testing, validation, and deployment phases to ensure successful delivery. Qualifications: MBA or equivalent degree from a reputed B-School, with specialization in Business Analytics, Strategy, or Technology Management. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with exposure to AI/BI concepts. Familiarity with statistical methods (hypothesis testing, A/B testing) and data analysis. Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities. Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau) and reporting frameworks. Ability to understand a business domain quickly and able to drive solutions Prior experience in consulting, presales, or technology-driven projects is a plus. Skills & Competencies: Analytical Tools: SQL, Excel, Python/R (for data analysis, hypothesis testing, and A/B testing). BI & Visualization: Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms for dashboards and reporting. AI/ML Awareness: Understanding of AI concepts, model outputs, and business applications. Business Skills: Requirement gathering, solution design, presales support, and client engagement. Soft Skills: Strong communication, presentation, and storytelling abilities; ability to simplify complex technical concepts for business stakeholders Consulting Mindset: Structured problem-solving, hypothesis-driven thinking
